hooks.command:
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || { printf '%s
' 'Stop validation: cannot resolve the Git repository root.' >&2; exit 2; }; cd "$root" || { printf '%s
' 'Stop validation: cannot enter the Git repository root.' >&2; exit 2; }; git diff --check >/dev/null || { printf '%s
' 'Stop validation: git diff --check failed.' >&2; exit 2; }; bash -n scripts/setup.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf '%s
' 'Stop validation: scripts/setup.sh syntax check failed.' >&2; exit 2; }
